_comment: Failure classes for tests/prove_task.py --unit 173_taskgroup_cancel. ref.py is also the validator's embedded oracle; build.py regenerates evals/tasks/173_taskgroup_cancel.json from harness.py + ref.py + validator_main.py. Equivalence was checked against CPython 3.13's asyncio.TaskGroup on every scenario that uses neither timeout nor cancel() (0 differences); CPython 3.12's TaskGroup differs on ~13% of them (its uncancel ordering), which is the intended discrimination.
